title: Bubble Shield Cornfield
description: A figure in a gas mask and hazmat suit stands inside a large transparent bubble, pressing a glowing pink hand against the surface. Neon blue and magenta energy lines radiate outward from the hand while iridescent bubbles float around them. The scene is set in a field of stylized purple corn with glowing blue cobs under a dark, swirling sky.
prompt: A mysterious figure wearing a full gas mask and hazmat suit stands inside a giant transparent bubble in the middle of a stylized purple cornfield. The figure presses one hand against the bubble wall, emitting intense glowing blue and magenta energy tendrils that spread across the sphere. Iridescent soap-like bubbles float around the scene. Dramatic dark swirling sky, bioluminescent corn with electric blue kernels, surreal and psychedelic atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
